title: Stuck: An Interactive Horror Fiction
author: Westley Kossuth
description:
It's 1998. You're a bass player on tour with your band. You fall asleep on the tour bus, and wake up to find the bus broken down and your bandmates missing. Leaving out the bass player, typical. You must investigate the creepy town you broke down outside of and unravel the mystery of what happened to your friends. You'll want sound on for this! The game has a soundtrack.

Made for Scream Jam 2023.



CONTENT WARNING - This game contains language, violence, gore and instances of emotional manipulation.
